ex.en: The chef cooked the fish to perfection and served it with fresh herbs.
ex.zh: 厨师把鱼做得恰到好处，配上新鲜香草端上桌。

words.note: to perfection 是固定搭配，表“恰到好处、完美地”。

ex.en: He only had a vague idea of what the job would involve.
ex.zh: 他对这份工作要做些什么只有模糊的了解。

words.note: be vague about sth 表对某事含糊其辞。

ex.en: Thousands of people gathered in the square to see the Pope.
ex.zh: 数千人聚集在广场上，想一睹教皇的风采。

words.note: Pope 首字母大写，指罗马教皇，是天主教领袖。

ex.en: The teacher made an exception and let him hand in the essay late.
ex.zh: 老师破例允许他晚交作文。

words.note: exception 是名词；without exception 表无例外。

ex.en: Losing the match hurt his ego more than he was willing to admit.
ex.zh: 输掉比赛伤了他的自尊，尽管他不愿承认。

words.note: ego 指自我、自尊；hurt sb's ego 即伤自尊。

ex.en: Doctors urge people to cut down on salt and sugar.
ex.zh: 医生敦促人们少吃盐和糖。

words.note: urge 后可接 sb to do sth；作名词用 an urge to do。

ex.en: Each employee may bring a spouse to the company dinner.
ex.zh: 每位员工可带配偶参加公司晚宴。

words.note: spouse 是配偶的正式统称，男女通用，公文常用。

ex.en: Our team scored a goal in the last minute and won the game.
ex.zh: 我们队在最后一分钟攻入一球，赢下了比赛。

words.note: score 指比分、得分；three score 表六十。

ex.en: The ferry takes tourists to a small isle off the coast every morning.
ex.zh: 渡船每天早上把游客送到离岸不远的一座小岛。

words.note: isle 多用于诗歌或地名，如 the Isle of Man。

ex.en: The zoo built a larger enclosure for the bears last summer.
ex.zh: 去年夏天动物园为熊建了更大的围场。

words.note: enclosure 指围场，也指信中附件；动词是 enclose。

ex.en: She will graduate from university next June and start work in July.
ex.zh: 她明年六月大学毕业，七月开始工作。

words.note: graduate 作名词指毕业生；搭配 graduate from 加学校。

ex.en: The long drought led to a severe famine in the region.
ex.zh: 长期干旱导致该地区发生严重饥荒。

words.note: famine 指大范围食物短缺；形容词 famished 表非常饿。

ex.en: Each salesperson has to meet a monthly quota of twenty orders.
ex.zh: 每位销售员每月必须完成二十单的定额。

words.note: quota 指定额、配额；meet the quota 表完成指标。

ex.en: The committee reached a unanimous decision to delay the project.
ex.zh: 委员会一致决定推迟该项目。

words.note: unanimous 指全体一致，常用 a unanimous decision。

ex.en: He poured scorn on the idea and refused to discuss it further.
ex.zh: 他对这个想法大加嘲讽，拒绝再讨论下去。

words.note: scorn 表轻蔑；pour scorn on sb 意为嘲笑某人。

ex.en: The building uses thermal energy from the ground to keep warm.
ex.zh: 这栋楼利用地下的热能取暖。

words.note: thermal 词根表“热”，常搭配 energy、power。

ex.en: Burning coal releases sulfur dioxide, which pollutes the air.
ex.zh: 燃烧煤炭会释放二氧化硫，污染空气。

words.note: sulfur 是硫，英式拼作 sulphur，元素符号 S。

ex.en: The film's stunning visual effects drew millions of viewers to cinemas.
ex.zh: 这部电影惊人的视觉效果吸引数百万观众走进影院。

words.note: visual 指视觉的，词根 vis- 表“看”，如 vision。

ex.en: The rescue team moved slowly across the rough terrain at night.
ex.zh: 救援队夜间在崎岖地形上缓慢前进。

words.note: terrain 指地势、地形，常用于军事和户外语境。

ex.en: She could not hide her grief at the funeral of her old friend.
ex.zh: 在老友的葬礼上，她无法掩饰悲痛。

words.note: grief 是名词悲痛；动词是 grieve，表哀悼。

ex.en: The students performed a rap song about protecting the environment.
ex.zh: 学生们表演了一首关于保护环境的说唱歌曲。

words.note: rap 指说唱乐或急促敲击；注意与 wrap 区分。

ex.en: The hotel gave us a free upgrade to a room with a sea view.
ex.zh: 酒店免费给我们升级到一间海景房。

words.note: upgrade 指升级、提升，反义词是 downgrade。

ex.en: The coach instructed the players to warm up before the match.
ex.zh: 教练指示球员赛前热身。

words.note: instruct 后接 sb to do sth；作“教授”较正式。

ex.en: The full data tables appear in the appendix at the back of the report.
ex.zh: 完整的数据表见报告后面的附录。

words.note: appendix 复数 appendices，也指人体阑尾。

ex.en: Virtually all students in the class passed the final exam.
ex.zh: 班里几乎所有学生都通过了期末考试。

words.note: virtually 意为“几乎、实际上”，不是“虚拟地”。

ex.en: The walk along the river was agreeable despite the cold wind.
ex.zh: 虽然风冷，沿河散步仍然惬意。

words.note: agreeable 指令人愉快的，也可指愿意同意的，接 to。

ex.en: Tourism plays an important role in the local economy.
ex.zh: 旅游业在当地经济中起着重要作用。

words.note: economy 指经济；economic 是经济的，economical 是节约的。

ex.en: The library is a meeting place for the whole local community.
ex.zh: 图书馆是整个当地社区的聚会场所。

words.note: community 指社区，也可指有共同特征的群体。

ex.en: The two witnesses gave a different version of what happened that night.
ex.zh: 两名目击者对那晚发生的事给出了不同说法。

words.note: version 指版本，也可指个人对事件的表述。

ex.en: Sprinkle a little salt on the potatoes before serving them.
ex.zh: 上桌前在土豆上撒一点盐。

words.note: sprinkle 指撒少量东西，常用 sprinkle A on B。
